entries.title: Entry 00 | Trailer
entries.description: Pokemon Heartgold is the next series! But first, let's learn a little about how this game came to be!

entries.title: Entry 01 | New Bark, New Beginnings!!!
entries.description: Our journey begins! Let's choose our starter Pokemon from this iconic trio!

entries.title: Entry 02 | Roads Of Cherrygrove
entries.description: We explore around Cherrygrove, a charming little town on the edge of the sea!

entries.title: Entry 03 | The Third Guarantee Of Life
entries.description: We venture into the Dark Cave and discover there are actually THREE guarantees of life!

entries.title: Entry 04 | The Elder Sprout
entries.description: We scale the Sprout Tower to challenge its Elder!

entries.title: Entry 05 | The Bird Man
entries.description: We take on the first gym leader of Johto: Falkner, the Bird Man!

entries.title: Entry 06 | Beep Beep I'm Mareep
entries.description: With Violet gym behind us, we journey on; and catch my favorite pokemon!

entries.title: Entry 07 | Karpe Diem
entries.description: We journey down beautiful route 32 and encounter the infamous magikarp trainer!

entries.title: Entry 08 | The Cave That Unites
entries.description: We journey through the union cave; that unites... two cave entrances I guess.

entries.title: Entry 09 | All's Not Well
entries.description: All's not well in the slowpoke well. Let's get down there and put a stop to it!

entries.title: Entry 10 | The Bug Collector
entries.description: We finally take on our next gym leader: Bugsy, the walking bug encyclopedia!

entries.title: Entry 11 | The Farfetch'd Test
entries.description: We move out from Azalea Town and into the mysterious Ilex forest — full of mystery, beauty, and Farfetch'd?

entries.title: Entry 12 | Baby's First Casino
entries.description: After arriving in Goldenrod city, we spend the day playing Voltorb Flip: the game that's not technically gambling!

entries.title: Entry 13 | The Golden City
entries.description: With our casino addiction fulfilled (for now), we turn our attention to the rest of this golden city!

entries.title: Entry 14 | The Cow Girl
entries.description: After we track down the gym leader, it's time for one of the trickier fights of the game!

entries.title: Entry 15 | Fear The Owl
entries.description: With our Noctowl finally evolved, it's time to give it some serious power!

entries.title: Entry 16 | Last Place
entries.description: We venture into National Park and take place in the bug catching contest! (it doesn't go well)

entries.title: Entry 17 | The Long Detour
entries.description: I finally arrive in Ecruteak! Only to get distracted and end up far, far away...

entries.title: Entry 18 | City Of History
entries.description: Detours aside, it times to explore this city of history!

entries.title: Entry 19 | The Necromancer
entries.description: We take on Morty, the mystic seer of the future! (although he's not a psychic trainer)

entries.title: Entry 20 | Union Underground
entries.description: With Surf and Strength added to our arsenal, the world just got a whole lot bigger!

entries.title: Entry 21 | Pokemon Puzzle League
entries.description: With Surf and Strength, most of the Ruins of Alph is accessible! So let's see what this mysterious place has to offer!

entries.title: Entry 22 | Tale Of Two Gyarados
entries.description: The angry lake beckons. Not only does it boast a shiny Gyarados, but a  very strong Magikarp as well!

entries.title: Entry 23 | Rocket Revengers
entries.description: We take the fight to Team Rocket in their own base!

entries.title: Entry 24 | The Nice Guy
entries.description: We take on Pryce, the Winter Trainer, for our fifth gym badge!

entries.title: Entry 25 | Through The Olivine
entries.description: With fifth badge in hand, we finally trek out towards the sea!

entries.title: Entry 26 | Catch Of The Day
entries.description: We finally catch another team member then explore the mysterious Whirl Islands!
